versions.name: Ben Delatour Scout Ranch Camp Jeffrey Summer
versions.address: 2331 County Road 68C Red Feather Lakes, Colorado 80545

features.note: An ATV program for older youth.
Shower house with twenty-four private stalls and on-demand hot water.
Four flush toilets at the shower house; campsites have pit latrines.
A working cattle ranch with corral rides and horsemanship instruction.
An official Scouting museum on the property.
Natural rock climbing on the ranch's rock formations, including The Thumb.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it.
